concept: Review and integration: a realistic, sustained personal relationship with environmental responsibility
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across major decisions, using real influence, and passing on care to others — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what environmental stewardship means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
